title: Find all distinct account IDs that satisfy both of the following conditions
question: Find all distinct account IDs that satisfy both of the following conditions: (1) the account is located in a district where the average salary (A11) exceeds 10,000 and was opened in or after 1997; and (2) the account has at least one transaction with an amount greater than 3000 USD. Additionally, for these accounts, compute the total number of such high-value transactions per account.

prediction.sql:
SELECT a."XCL_001" AS account_id, COUNT(t."XCL_046") AS high_value_transaction_count
FROM account AS a
INNER JOIN district AS d ON a."XCL_002" = d."XCL_017"
INNER JOIN trans AS t ON a."XCL_001" = t."XCL_047"
WHERE d."XCL_031" > 10000
  AND a."XCL_004" >= '1997-01-01'
  AND t."XCL_051" > 3000
GROUP BY a."XCL_001"
